# Stop All Damage Over Time

Source: [wiki article 4461](../archive/4461.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Stop All Damage Over Time](../../api/actions/stop-all-damage-over-time.md).

<a id="wiki-4461-n1"></a>

- Stop All Damage Over Time targets scripted DoTs on selected players, rather than all natural damage-over-time effects.
